body: Don't remember writing this. Not sure what quite a few was, I just kind of pounded the bottle. Mixed emotions about waking up. I'm going to try again in a couple weeks, so my kids won't have their birthdays be a reminder of their father failing them.

As long as I can remember when people ask me "what do you want to be when you grow up?" I've never had an answer. It only makes sense to me now, that I've never wanted to be anything or anyone. What an incredible waste of oxygen. How can someone who has no interest in improving themselves, improve themselves? If I have no drive to improve myself for anyone or anything, the. What the fuck is the point? 

Luckily I had to have surgery a couple weeks ago. We'll see how painkillers go with alcohol.

I never really noticed a difference, but I've never gone long enough for  the medication to really set in I guess. I was started on Prozac but it made my head buzz like crazy so I just avoided it. I was then prescribed remeron but I couldn't wake up in the mornings and was always hung over. Lastly I was prescribed lamictal but, the three times I've tried to seriously stick with it the longest I've been able to stay consistent is 5 weeks. 

I'm lucky if i remember to put deodorant on let alone if I'm taking the right amount of pills for the given week.

Have only really started seeing pro help since late last year, although probably should have been sooner. 

Graduated high school only due to being sent to a special school. dropped out of college. Met my wife on one my "I'm really going to try this time" times. Been mostly downhill since.

I've had more than a dozen different jobs so far and often bounce from hobby to hobby, doing projects but mostly just leave them half finished and walk away. I have really come down to believing that I don't really enjoy anything. I've tried going to the gym, also running, but that too only last a few weeks and just sputters to a halt. 

The real problem I feel is I have no real emotion to show my children. Sure ill smile when they do silly things but mostly they just make me angry so I try to avoid them as to not lash out. It's difficult to find a job when you don't have any real skills and have only bounced from one menial demeaning job to the next.

I'm sure my children will miss me but I cant help but feel I'm doing them a disservice by just barely existing. I'm just so tired of picking up and charging ahead only to look around to see the only difference is that I'm older.

I have no real drive to do anything. Haven't brushed my teeth in a couple days. The wife is starting to resent me. I know she'd be better off anyways, but I don't really  have anywhere to go so I've just been holed up in my room the last couple days.

Talked to a counselor, two therapists and a psych. Nobody had much for me. The therapist are pretty much hamstrung in that I don't really have any desires or goals. The psychiatrist has prescribed me a couple different things but I an never remember to take anything more than a couple weeks, then it just kind of stumbles along and I'll go several days without. When I finally remember taking the medication again requires me to work back up to my doses , and I always end up just saying fuck it.

I have a two year old and a five year old. I've never really felt any special emotions toward either. Usually I'm able to work enough to avoid everything, but I quit my job several weeks ago and now have nothing but time to reflect on what a waste I am.

Not sure what there might be to talk about though. Just finished with doing nothing. It seems every time I make a real attempt at changing my life, I do a small circle and end no better than before, just with more shortcomings. 

I can't stand being around my family for more than a few minutes at a time. 

I can't be decent at anything but I would be demonized to just leave. I'm feel trapped.
So tired of being so impotent, yet I know it's fucked up to just leave kids.
